verdict.rationale: Bevy is distributed exclusively as a Rust crate — 'Bevy is just a normal Rust dependency. You can either add it to an existing Rust project' (bevy-docs-21) — and web support means compiling Rust to WASM, not installing an npm-style package into a JS bundler pipeline with tree-shaking. No evidence shows Bevy publishing to npm or supporting JS-style import/bundle/tree-shake workflows.
